scope: Restart from P21 using C architecture and supervision. D changes paired curriculum, learning rate and budget; not a single-factor ablation. Sources protected including earlier P22 files.
schedule: Four worlds per batch: single,select,update,update. Each contributes present target, other present target (duplicate for singleton), absent target, reversed original. First2 short; third alternates short/long; fourth long. 16 task examples and8 old Chinese replay. No final-wording training.
selection: Fixed last checkpoint; last two small development and full development >=95% all metrics, false unknown<=5%, old Chinese NLL<=P18*1.05, exact organism. All seeds required before final test.
